INSERT INTO users (tg_user_id, username, first_name, language_code)
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
        ON CONFLICT (tg_user_id) DO UPDATE
           SET username = EXCLUDED.username,
               first_name = EXCLUDED.first_name,
               language_code = EXCLUDED.language_code,
               last_seen_at = now()
